body.x: Geonaute(www.geonaute.com) showcased 360-Degree Action Camera at 'Showstoppers' of the '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
The company calls "the first 360 degree action camera." and explains "The camera is using three lenses, and we conbined videos taken by three scenes into one file."
According to a news report, the camera takes Ultra HD photos; up to 4096x2048 pixels, and you’ll be working with Mono audio with AAC compression, MP4 video, and JPG photos.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
